stage: RWASM-01 partial: real RAW decode and native parity
sharedDecodeImplementation: The same crate function decodes and reports on native and wasm32; SHA-256 covers every decoded sensor sample in canonical little-endian form; the JSON also contains dimensions, bit depth, sample count and five deterministic values.

browser.worker: Dedicated module worker; one RAW at a time; terminated after response
browser.inputBound: Worker rejects empty or over-128-MiB buffers before wasm-bindgen copies them; a UI host must also preflight before reading or transferring a file

fixtures.nativeAndWasmError: Failed to decode image, possibly corrupt image. Origin error was: ljpeg: not a valid raw file, found DQT
fixtures.decoderPath: DngDecoder::raw_image -> plain_image_from_ifd selects LJpegDecompressor for 12-bit ModernJPEG -> LJpegDecompressor::new rejects DQT

fixtures.authorization: One local user-authorized read-only test copy; not CC0 and not shared
fixtures.sourcePathInputHashExifAndSampleValues: withheld; private native report remains outside repository

checks.nativeReferenceDecode: pass for CC0 Canon DNG and private Fujifilm RAF; Blackmagic DNG unsupported by pinned decoder
checks.browserWorkerParity: pass for CC0 Canon DNG and private Fujifilm RAF; Blackmagic DNG returns the same unsupported-decoder error as native
checks.workerCancellationDuringDecode: Chromium AbortSignal test terminated the worker after its immediate pre-decode status; no completed report was received
checks.decodedAllocationAndDimensionLimits: not implemented; the input bound does not constrain decoded allocations
checks.privateOriginalIntegrity: read-only O_NOFOLLOW|O_NOATIME SHA-256 and size/mtime/inode matched the pre-test baseline

workerLifecycleGate.inputPreflight: 1 byte to 128 MiB; client exposes a size predicate for File.size before reading, and worker rechecks before wasm-bindgen copies the buffer
workerLifecycleGate.timeout: 30-second default, capped at 120 seconds; timer termination covered by a deterministic fake-worker test, not by waiting for a real RAW timeout
workerLifecycleGate.unitTests: 3 passed: size/timeout bounds, abort resolution/termination, timer resolution/termination

realBrowserTest.input: one local user-authorized read-only RAW buffer; image pixels, metadata and input hash were not logged
realBrowserTest.sequence: Worker sent its decode-start status immediately before synchronous rawler decode; the page aborted via AbortSignal and received reason=aborted

next: Add a pinned-decoder preflight for decoded dimensions/allocation (or reject safely before rawler allocates), and malformed-input tests; also exercise the real-worker timeout rather than only the deterministic timer unit test. Keep Blackmagic 12-bit CinemaDNG explicitly unsupported unless a safe source-pinned decoder path is established.
